description: Defines a Color struct representing ARGB and CMYK colors with parsing, conversion, and comparison functionalities within the MigraDoc.DocumentObjectModel namespace.

classes.name: Color
classes.description: Represents a color in ARGB and CMYK formats, with methods for creation, parsing, comparison, and string representation.

methods.name: Color(uint argb)
methods.description: Constructs a Color from an ARGB uint value, with special handling for zero value based on backward compatibility.

methods.name: Color(byte r, byte g, byte b)
methods.description: Constructs an RGB Color with full opacity.

methods.name: Color(byte a, byte r, byte g, byte b)
Color(double alpha, double cyan, double magenta, double yellow, double black)
methods.description: Constructs a CMYK Color with specified alpha and CMYK components.

methods.name: Color(double cyan, double magenta, double yellow, double black)
methods.description: Constructs a CMYK Color with default alpha 100.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a string to create a Color object, supporting hex, color names, and formats.

methods.name: GetMixedTransparencyColor
methods.description: Returns a color with adjusted transparency.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the color, in CMYK, RGB, or hex format.

methods.name: FromRgbColor
methods.description: Creates a Color from an existing color with a specified alpha.

methods.name: FromCmykColor
methods.description: Creates a CMYK Color from an existing color with specified alpha.
